entries.zh: 本范围仅涉及版本说明自动化、文档和相关测试维护。SpaceMouse、力/力矩、Pico、主从臂的实现，以及 Python 读取器、启动器和 SDK 版本均未改动。
entries.en: This range contains maintenance for release-note automation, documentation and related tests only. SpaceMouse, force/torque, Pico and master–follower arm implementations, Python readers and launchers, and the SDK version are unchanged.

entries.zh: 新增双语草稿生成流程，以目标提交的已发布正式祖先版本为基线，固定比较 SHA。校验输出结构和条目引用的提交范围。目标版本的 Actions 流程仅支持默认分支手动触发；模型生成需要 `OPENAI_API_KEY`。准备成功后，缺少 Key、生成失败或输出无效时保留带状态的 Git 摘要。草稿制品保留 90 天，不自动纳入正式 Release。
entries.en: Add bilingual draft generation using a published stable ancestor release as the baseline and fixed comparison SHAs. Validate output structure and entry commit references against the range. At the target commit, the Actions workflow runs manually on the default branch; model generation requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`. After successful preparation, missing keys, generation failures or invalid output retain Git summaries with status labels. Draft artifacts are retained for 90 days and are not automatically included in official releases.

entries.zh: 新增本机 ChatGPT 登录方式的草稿脚本和 systemd 用户定时器安装器。安装后每十分钟检查默认分支，按目标 SHA 将双语草稿归档并推送至 `automation/release-notes`。默认跳过已完成的 SHA，失败后等待一小时重试；`--force` 可跳过这些限制。构建工作流排除该归档分支的 push，并将 tag push 限定为 `v*`。
entries.en: Add a local draft script using ChatGPT login and an installer for a systemd user timer. Once installed, it checks the default branch every ten minutes and archives and pushes bilingual drafts by target SHA to `automation/release-notes`. It skips completed SHAs and waits one hour after failures by default; `--force` bypasses these gates. The build workflow excludes pushes to the archive branch and limits tag pushes to `v*`.

entries.zh: 新增本机定时任务与手动 API 工作流的配置说明，涵盖认证要求、草稿位置、状态检查、停用和失败恢复。维护者流程明确要求审核草稿后再纳入正式版本说明。
entries.en: Add setup guides for the local timer and manual API workflow, covering authentication requirements, draft locations, status checks, disabling the timer and failure recovery. The maintainer guide requires draft review before inclusion in official release notes.

uncertainties.zh: `docs/codex-release-notes.md` 仍有“push/手动触发”的旧描述，与目标工作流仅配置 `workflow_dispatch` 不一致；触发方式以工作流代码为准，文档仍需统一。
uncertainties.en: `docs/codex-release-notes.md` still mentions push/manual triggering, while the target workflow configures only `workflow_dispatch`. The workflow code establishes manual-only triggering; the documentation still needs reconciliation.

uncertainties.zh: 本次仅静态检查代码和文档，未运行脚本或测试。定时器是否已安装、认证是否可用，以及草稿生成和归档推送是否成功，均未确认。
uncertainties.en: This review inspected code and documentation only; no scripts or tests were run. Timer installation, usable authentication, successful draft generation and archive pushes remain unverified.
